checks: four real HTTP servers, distinct node identities and healthy readiness endpoints
mirror combines two independently pinned authorities
local follows both original authority feeds through a mirror; replay is idempotent
signing-key rotation preserves node identity and continues through a relay without re-pinning
ordinary-user browse/profile/export/read-only tokens; CSRF and admin/reviewer boundaries hold
